text_excerpt: Amputation and Chemotherapy for Osteosarcoma We are seeking dogs whose owners have decided on the standard of care treatment option for canine osteosarcoma. This includes amputation and chemotherapy. This study aims to check for the spread (metastasis) of the cancer and will follow patients until the time which the dog develops metastasis. We will use this information to compare against our other clinical trials. oncology,recruiting,dogs general-page --> Amputation and Chemotherapy for Osteosarcoma | Research | Virginia Tech Skip to
